tinVerify.title: Verify Your TIN
tinVerify.body: Your TIN is required on all invoices. Without it, 10% WHT applies to ALL payments you receive.
tinVerify.nrsNote: Managed by NRS (Nigeria Revenue Service, formerly FIRS)
tinVerify.pendingNote: Verification takes 1–2 minutes via NRS. We'll notify you automatically.

vatSetup.title: VAT Setup
vatSetup.exemptTitle: Good news — you may be exempt from filing VAT returns
vatSetup.exemptBody: Businesses under ₦100M turnover are exempt from filing VAT returns. However you MUST still charge 7.5% VAT on all invoices.
vatSetup.requiredBody: Your business must file VAT returns by the 21st of each month.

einvoice.title: E-Invoicing
einvoice.phaseSmall: Mandatory from July 2027 for your business size. Set up now — banks offer faster invoice financing to e-invoice-ready businesses.
einvoice.phaseMedium: Pilot phase active. Mandatory July 1 2026. Apply for FIRSMBS integration now.
einvoice.phaseLarge: ⚠️ E-INVOICING ENFORCEMENT IS ACTIVE. Non-compliance = ₦200,000 penalty + 100% of tax due.
